dangerous.setup: You notice a slightly shifted brick in the wall. Someone hid something there, recently.

choices.label: Examine it discreetly
choices.flavor: Behind the brick, a wad of credits and a slip of paper with numbers. An active stash.

choices.label: Report it to a corrupt guard for a cut
choices.flavor: He takes 60%, leaves you 40%. It's a clean transaction in a dirty place.

choices.label: Ignore it and move on
choices.flavor: You keep going. Someone else will find it.

dangerous.setup: A wounded man is slumped in a dark corner. He's still breathing. A bloody knife lies at his feet — his own, not his attacker's.

choices.label: Help him — treat him and call for help
choices.flavor: He regains consciousness. His eyes search for yours. 'Thanks. I won't forget.' This man knows things.

choices.label: Search him discreetly
choices.flavor: He's not dead. He's pretending. You realize too late. His fingers close around your wrist.

choices.label: Take the knife and leave
choices.flavor: A fine blade. He saw you do it but he can't follow you. Not now.

choices.label: Pass without stopping
choices.flavor: You keep going. Not your problem. You wonder for three corridors if you were right.

dangerous.setup: Three children surround you with smiles that are too wide. They're coordinated. You've seen this before — not kids playing, kids working.

choices.label: Keep your hands in your pockets and back away fast
choices.flavor: You break the formation. They exchange a look. Maybe next time.

choices.label: Grab the one getting closest
choices.flavor: He struggles and shouts. Adults watch. You're the villain in this scene.

choices.label: Give them something — play along
choices.flavor: You hand over a few credits. They leave satisfied. Cheaper than what they would've taken.

dangerous.setup: A cracked-open metal door lets out light and a voice counting money aloud. Laughter around it.

choices.label: Watch from the corridor
choices.flavor: An underground dice game. You spot the cheating system in two minutes. You can exploit that.

choices.label: Go in and join
choices.flavor: They accept you warily. Luck turns — your way, tonight.

choices.label: Go in and place a high bet
choices.flavor: Looks shift. You play. You lose. They're good.

choices.label: Keep going without stopping
choices.flavor: The door closes behind you as if you never existed.

dangerous.setup: Fresh graffiti on a wall — a simple map, symbols. Someone pointed something out to someone, and you're here before the other guy.

choices.label: Follow the directions
choices.flavor: A stash. Well hidden, well stocked. You got lucky this time.

choices.label: Erase the graffiti and wait
choices.flavor: Someone arrives. Looking for the message. You can talk to them, or steal what they meant to collect.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.flavor: It probably wasn't for you anyway.

dangerous.setup: A service cabinet is open. Inside, maintenance gear — and something clearly out of place.

choices.label: Search the cabinet thoroughly
choices.flavor: Clean spare parts, a weapon hidden in a rag, a codebook. A quiet jackpot.

choices.label: Take just one thing and close it
choices.flavor: You take what looks most valuable. Discreetly. Efficiently.

choices.label: Report it to a guard
choices.flavor: He investigates. He comes back. He thanks you curtly. Two credits in your hand.

dangerous.setup: You hear an argument behind a closed door. Voices — one loud, one pleading. Something's wrong.

choices.label: Open the door and step in
choices.flavor: The loud man steps back, surprised. The pleading one flees. He looks at you.

choices.label: Listen first to understand
choices.flavor: A debt. He wants to be paid. You understand who's in the wrong. You can use the information.

choices.label: Knock on the door — make your presence known
choices.flavor: Silence falls. The door opens. The loud one stares at you. The situation is under control — for now.

choices.label: Walk on
choices.flavor: Not your business. Not your problem. Both voices continue behind you.

dangerous.setup: An open vent leads to a section of the station on no map. Wide enough to crawl through.

choices.label: Enter the vent
choices.flavor: Dark, narrow, then suddenly open. A hidden room. Crates. People sleep here.

choices.label: Close the vent and leave
choices.flavor: What you saw, you'd rather not know. Some spaces are secret for good reasons.

dangerous.setup: A makeshift pharmacy — products on a tarp, a woman sitting behind it who knows every formula without looking at the labels.

choices.label: Buy some medicine
choices.flavor: She sells you what you need without asking why. The price is fair.

choices.label: Talk to her — ask for local info
choices.flavor: She knows everyone who got hurt this week. A living intelligence map.

choices.label: Steal what you want
choices.flavor: She screams. Everyone turns. That wasn't a good idea.

dangerous.setup: Fresh blood trails lead from a corridor to a door. Recent. Maybe ten minutes.

choices.label: Follow the trail
choices.flavor: It leads to a dead man. His belongings are untouched — his attackers were in a hurry.

choices.label: Don't follow the trail
choices.flavor: You turn at the opposite corner. You saw nothing.

choices.label: Report it to the authorities
choices.flavor: Guards arrive. They question you. You waste time. They don't thank you.

dangerous.setup: A man offers you information in exchange for a favor. He won't say what favor until you agree.

choices.label: Accept without knowing
choices.flavor: He wants you to deliver something somewhere. What it is, you'd rather not know. But it pays.

choices.label: Ask what it is first
choices.flavor: He weighs your curiosity. He decides you deserve a partial answer. Enough to decide.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.flavor: He shrugs. 'You look like a careful guy. That's probably good.'

dangerous.setup: You find a comms terminal on and unlocked. The active session gives access to private messages.

choices.label: Read the messages
choices.flavor: Financial details. Coordinates. A list of names. Valuable information... and dangerous.

choices.label: Close the session without reading
choices.flavor: You don't touch what isn't yours. It might be a test.

choices.label: Send an anonymous message from the session
choices.flavor: You cause a disruption. Someone's going to worry. Maybe they'll pay to know who.

dangerous.setup: An abandoned bag in a corner. Too new to have been forgotten by accident.

choices.label: Open it
choices.flavor: Quality equipment. Credits. A terminal with a unique address.

choices.label: Watch it from a distance
choices.flavor: Someone comes back for it after ten minutes. They didn't forget it. They were hiding it.

choices.label: Leave without touching it
choices.flavor: Some booby-trapped bags are designed to look tempting.

dangerous.setup: A network of stacked crates creates an alternate passage to a section of the station. Discreet. Unofficial.

choices.label: Take this path
choices.flavor: The passage leads to an unwatched zone. People live there. Things pass through.

choices.label: Stay on the official path
choices.flavor: Safer. Less interesting.

dangerous.setup: Someone hands you an envelope without a word and walks off the other way. Their back reveals nothing.

choices.label: Open the envelope immediately
choices.flavor: Credits. A slip of paper with an address. No name.

choices.label: Chase them for an explanation
choices.flavor: They speed up. When they turn the corner, they're gone.

choices.label: Toss the envelope without opening it
choices.flavor: You'll never know. Maybe the best decision you made today.

dangerous.setup: Two guards argue in front of a secure access point. They're not paying attention to what passes.

choices.label: Use the distraction to slip through
choices.flavor: You get through. Beyond it, a private storage zone. No one watching.

choices.label: Join their argument to distract them further
choices.flavor: It spirals into absurdity. A third guard arrives. Everyone turns to you.

choices.label: Keep walking
choices.flavor: Their problems aren't yours.

dangerous.setup: An old sign points to 'level -3 — restricted access'. The sign is recent. Someone added an arrow underneath by hand.

choices.label: Follow the handwritten arrow
choices.flavor: The arrow leads to an informal market. People selling things that belong down there.

choices.label: Follow the official direction
choices.flavor: Access blocked. The sign lied, or things have changed since.

choices.label: Find out who added the arrow
choices.flavor: You track someone down. They're surprised. They explain what's below.

dangerous.setup: A burnt smell comes from a side corridor. Not an emergency — someone's cooking something illegal.

choices.label: Go take a look
choices.flavor: An improvised chem lab. The operator looks at you. 'You buying or you leaving?'

choices.label: Ignore the smell
choices.flavor: Not your business. Well-run illegal operations have their own smell of permanence.

choices.label: Report it to the guards for a reward
choices.flavor: The guards get the lab. You get little, and an enemy you didn't see.

dangerous.setup: A woman standing in a corridor has been watching you approach for a long time. Too long. She was waiting for someone. Maybe you.

choices.label: Approach her directly
choices.flavor: 'You're late.' She hands you something. She leaves before you can ask a question.

choices.label: Change direction
choices.flavor: She doesn't follow you. But her eyes do, until you turn the corner.

choices.label: Watch from a distance to understand the situation
choices.flavor: She's still waiting. Someone else arrives. You watch each other. The deal happens without you.

dangerous.setup: Deep in the zone, you find a room the locals seem to avoid. No sign. Just a space no one crosses.

choices.label: Go in
choices.flavor: There's something in the walls. A secret stash whose last users forgot it existed, or are dead.

choices.label: Watch the locals pass by
choices.flavor: Some speed up. Others pretend not to see the door. Something happened here.

choices.label: Mark the spot to come back later
choices.flavor: You note the location. Next time you'll be prepared.

dangerous.setup: A burglary is underway in a commercial unit. Discreet, professional. They haven't noticed you've seen them yet.

choices.label: Join the crew — offer to help
choices.flavor: They accept you warily. You take your cut. What you all found wasn't part of their plan.

choices.label: Report them for the reward
choices.flavor: The militia arrives. They flee but leave gear behind. You collect your reward.

choices.label: Walk past and see nothing
choices.flavor: What happens in the dark corners of stations isn't your concern.

choices.label: Watch them finish, then search what they missed
choices.flavor: They missed the important part. Burglars, like everyone, don't see what's outside their plan.

dangerous.setup: A data terminal is open on what looks like a list of names — people, ships, places. An active operational file.

choices.label: Copy the entire list
choices.flavor: Three factions would pay for this. You'll pay to find out what you just took.

choices.label: Copy just a fragment and close the terminal
choices.flavor: You take enough to negotiate. Not enough to be truly dangerous. Delicate balance.

choices.label: Close the terminal without taking anything
choices.flavor: What you don't know can't get you killed. That's the theory.

peaceful.setup: An old man sitting on a bench watches you approach. He has the look of someone with a lot of time and a lot to say, if asked.

choices.label: Sit down and listen
choices.flavor: He talks about how things were before. What this station used to be. People no longer here. Useful and sad in equal measure.

choices.label: Ask him what he knows about the station
choices.flavor: He knows things the information boards will never say. He points you in a direction.

choices.label: Pass by with a nod
choices.flavor: He nods back. Minimal contact is still something.

peaceful.setup: An improvised indoor garden occupies what used to be a meeting room. Potted plants, UV lights, and someone watering carefully.

choices.label: Offer to help
choices.flavor: She accepts. Two hours together. She tells you about botany, you learn about medicinal plants.

choices.label: Ask what she's growing
choices.flavor: 'Things that help.' She sells you medicinal plants below market price.

choices.label: Watch from the corridor
choices.flavor: There's something soothing about someone tending to something alive. You leave slightly calmer.

peaceful.setup: A mechanic works on a ship in the dock with meticulous precision. He's clearly looking for something specific.

choices.label: Offer to help — you have parts
choices.flavor: He accepts. You use one of your parts. In exchange he looks over your ship.

choices.label: Offer to help — you have hands
choices.flavor: Two hours of work. He pays you in credits and know-how.

choices.label: Ask his opinion on your ship
choices.flavor: He glances over. 'Your left engine's about to go. You've got eight hours before it gets interesting.'

peaceful.setup: A group of residents holds an informal meeting in a common room. They're debating something that clearly concerns the station.

choices.label: Join the meeting and listen
choices.flavor: A resource distribution problem. You have useful information. They listen despite your outsider status.

choices.label: Watch from the doorway without entering
choices.flavor: You understand local politics. Useful for not stepping into a conflict.

choices.label: Offer a quick solution and leave
choices.flavor: It surprises everyone. It might solve the problem. You'll never know — you're already gone.

peaceful.setup: A child approaches you with a serious question about space — where you've been, what you've seen, whether what they say about stations beyond the sector is true.

choices.label: Answer honestly — everything you know
choices.flavor: Their eyes widen. They call other kids over. You spend an hour telling stories. Best hour of your day.

choices.label: Tell them a story — true or made up
choices.flavor: They won't know the difference. But their parents, listening from the corridor, do. You've impressed them.

choices.label: Politely send them away
choices.flavor: They leave disappointed. You remember the first time an adult said no to you like that.

peaceful.setup: An informal library has set up in a former commercial unit. Books on makeshift shelves. An old man at the counter accepts donations.

choices.label: Give some credits
choices.flavor: He thanks you and lets you read whatever you want. You find something useful.

choices.label: Borrow something without paying
choices.flavor: He saw you. He says nothing. He notes something. Libraries have their own debts.

choices.label: Donate something you no longer need
choices.flavor: He adds it to the shelves with care. 'Good things find their place.' You leave slightly lighter.

peaceful.setup: An improvised food market takes over a corridor — local producers with small quantities of real food.

choices.label: Buy provisions
choices.flavor: Real food. Not reconstituted. You pack it with more care than usual.

choices.label: Taste a stall's offering and negotiate
choices.flavor: She's proud of her produce. She gives you a fair price because you knew how to appreciate it.

choices.label: Look without buying
choices.flavor: Fresh food here costs a fortune. You're not necessarily wrong to resist.

peaceful.setup: A musician plays in a busy corridor. Not for money — no hat out. He plays because he plays.

choices.label: Stop and really listen
choices.flavor: You stay ten minutes. He doesn't look at you. When he stops he asks your opinion. The conversation that follows is out of context.

choices.label: Leave him some credits
choices.flavor: He looks at the money. 'I don't play for that.' He leaves. You feel light.

choices.label: Pass without stopping
choices.flavor: The music continues behind you. You still hear it three corridors later.

peaceful.setup: A community care room — a few residents looking after others with whatever means they have.

choices.label: Offer your help
choices.flavor: They need hands. You spend an hour helping. In return they treat what's wrong with you.

choices.label: Ask to be treated yourself
choices.flavor: They look at your wounds. They do what they can. Not a clinic, but effective.

choices.label: Watch and leave
choices.flavor: The solidarity here is real. A reminder that it exists.

peaceful.setup: A corridor leads to a terrace with a view of open space — a massive, unexpected porthole.

choices.label: Sit down and watch space
choices.flavor: You spend an hour there. Doing nothing. The void has its uses once you stop fearing it.

choices.label: Find someone to talk to here
choices.flavor: A pilot on break. She knows routes. She shares one with you.

industrial.setup: A machine has stopped. A technician lies underneath, legs sticking out. Fists pounding on the metal.

choices.label: Offer to help — you understand mechanisms
choices.flavor: Together you fix the problem. He pays you in spare parts and access to the internal network.

choices.label: Walk on — his problems aren't yours
choices.flavor: The pounding continues. The machine doesn't restart. Not your problem.

choices.label: Watch how he works — learn
choices.flavor: You observe for twenty minutes. You understand something about propulsion systems you didn't before.

industrial.setup: A pressurized pipe leaks slightly. Technicians walk by without stopping — normal here, or they're not authorized to fix it.

choices.label: Try to fix it with what you have
choices.flavor: It holds. Not perfectly. But it holds. A supervisor saw you. Impressed, then annoyed.

choices.label: Report the issue to the maintenance office
choices.flavor: They note it. They thank you. A small reward for vigilance that saved them an incident.

choices.label: Pass, avoiding the leak
choices.flavor: You don't care. The station apparently doesn't either.

industrial.setup: The forgotten storage room — a door that doesn't appear on current plans but you noticed it in the corridor.

choices.label: Open the door and explore
choices.flavor: Parts from the original construction. Obsolete for some machines but rare. Valuable to collectors.

choices.label: Find out who owns this corridor
choices.flavor: An old technician. He'd forgotten about it. He lets you take something in exchange for the reminder.

industrial.setup: A production robot has left its line and spins in circles in a corridor, repeating a pointless gesture.

choices.label: Try to reprogram it
choices.flavor: You find the access panel. A basic code error. It resumes its line. No one will know it was broken.

choices.label: Let it be — someone else's problem
choices.flavor: Someone will eventually deal with it. Or not. Inefficiency here is a natural resource.

choices.label: Shut the robot down completely
choices.flavor: It stops. The repetitive gesture stops with it. A strange relief.

industrial.setup: The crew cafeteria is open — long tables, metal trays, the smell of reconstituted protein. A few technicians on break watch you enter.

choices.label: Sit down and start a conversation
choices.flavor: They talk about their work with a technical pride that teaches you more about the station than any info board.

choices.label: Eat quickly and leave
choices.flavor: The food is functional. It does the job. You leave with a bit more energy.

choices.label: Listen to the conversations without joining in
choices.flavor: A security issue. An unstable section. Useful info to avoid wandering in by accident.

industrial.setup: A cart of spare parts sits unattended in a corridor. The parts are labeled but not counted.

choices.label: Discreetly take a few parts
choices.flavor: The temptation is real. You take two. No one will notice.

choices.label: Find whoever's responsible for the cart
choices.flavor: A distracted technician. He thanks you for watching his gear. A small reward.

choices.label: Pass, ignoring the cart
choices.flavor: Not your gear, not your problem.

industrial.setup: An artisan forge in an alcove — someone working metal with manual tools, an ancient technique in a spacefaring context.

choices.label: Watch the work with respect
choices.flavor: The craftsman looks up. He appreciates being truly watched. He shows you something of his technique.

choices.label: Ask to buy something
choices.flavor: He works to order. What's on hand is already sold. But he could make something for tomorrow.

choices.label: Offer to help
choices.flavor: He hesitates. 'You got useful hands or curious hands?' You work. You learn.

industrial.setup: A restricted access to the reactor zone is open — propped open with a wedged piece of metal. Deliberate.

choices.label: Go through and see what's there
choices.flavor: A secondary storage zone offline since a restructuring. Forgotten equipment.

choices.label: Remove the metal piece and close the access
choices.flavor: You secured it. A supervisor might see you do it. Might not.

choices.label: Leave it as is — not your business
choices.flavor: Someone had a reason to leave that door open. Maybe not a good one.

scientific.setup: A researcher is visibly stuck on something. He stares at his terminal with a fixity that suggests hours without progress.

choices.label: Offer a fresh look — no expertise, just a new angle
choices.flavor: You see something he stopped seeing. He realizes the problem in ten seconds. Embarrassed and grateful.

choices.label: Ask him what he's working on
choices.flavor: He explains. At length. Fascinating or incomprehensible depending on your interest level. But he's happy to talk.

choices.label: Leave him to his work
choices.flavor: The researcher doesn't need you. He needs time.

scientific.setup: A laboratory with the door ajar. Inside, machines doing things you don't understand, and no one watching.

choices.label: Enter and examine the machines
choices.flavor: Some machines have readout panels. You partly understand. You note things down.

choices.label: Take something that looks portable and useful
choices.flavor: An experimental object. You don't know what it is. Maybe that's why it's interesting.

choices.label: Close the door and say nothing
choices.flavor: A lab's security is someone else's problem.

scientific.setup: A public terminal displays results from an ongoing experiment. Real-time data you can read if you get close.

choices.label: Read and try to understand
choices.flavor: The data measures something. You recognize the trends. What they mean escapes you, but you get an overall impression.

choices.label: Download the data to a portable terminal
choices.flavor: It might have value to someone. Information is currency.

scientific.setup: An experimental subject — human, post-augmentation — rests in a recovery corridor. He watches you with modified eyes.

choices.label: Talk to him — ask how he's doing
choices.flavor: 'Better than before. Differently than before. Not the same thing.' He smiles with muscles that don't quite smile normally.

choices.label: Offer him something — water, food
choices.flavor: He accepts with real gratitude. What he's going through might deserve a bit of basic kindness.

choices.label: Pass without stopping
choices.flavor: He wasn't asking for anything. You owe him nothing. Probably true.

scientific.setup: An archivist is surrounded by physical files he's visibly trying to sort by a system that escapes him.

choices.label: Offer to help sort
choices.flavor: Two hours of work together. He's happy. He lets you read whatever you want from the archives in return.

choices.label: Ask if the archives have anything useful about stations
choices.flavor: He searches. He finds. Information about lost routes, hidden stations.

scientific.setup: A corridor leads to an indoor greenhouse — plants with no botanical reason to be together, but there, carefully tended.

choices.label: Explore the greenhouse
choices.flavor: A collection of space medicinal plants. Some unavailable at normal markets.

choices.label: Talk to the botanist working there
choices.flavor: He talks about each plant with an intensity beyond botany. He gives you one for your ailments.

scientific.setup: An observation room looks onto an ongoing experiment — something large, slow, altering something in space.

choices.label: Stay and watch as long as it takes
choices.flavor: You don't understand everything. But you see something change. Enough for today.

choices.label: Ask a technician for an explanation
choices.flavor: He's delighted to be asked. He explains more than you wanted to know.

scientific.setup: An experimental prototype runs in an open alcove. No one's watching. The machine is doing something uncertain.

choices.label: Interact with the machine
choices.flavor: It analyzes something about you. It produces a result that resembles a full medical recommendation.

choices.label: Study the machine without touching it
choices.flavor: It seems to measure biological parameters. Whatever it records will be accessible to someone.

choices.label: Unplug it — it shouldn't run unsupervised
choices.flavor: Somewhere in the station a silent alarm triggers. A researcher runs toward the alcove.

scientific.setup: A researcher is looking for test subjects with an urgency that doesn't match the experiment's description.

choices.label: Agree to participate — it's paid
choices.flavor: The experiment is benign. What it measures might not be. You walk out with something.

choices.label: Refuse but ask what it is
choices.flavor: He explains. The explanation raises more questions than it answers. But he gives you something for your interest.

choices.label: Recommend someone else to him
choices.flavor: He's grateful for the lead. The recommendation creates a light obligation on your part.

scientific.setup: An experiment has clearly gone wrong — spilled products, two assistants staring at each other without speaking, a terminal showing errors.

choices.label: Offer practical help — you know nothing but that's two more hands
choices.flavor: They accept. You spend an hour cleaning something you don't understand. They're grateful.

choices.label: Use the confusion to grab something off a bench
choices.flavor: A reagent, a component, something. They don't see you. What you took has clear value.

choices.label: Pass, avoiding eye contact
choices.flavor: Not your problem. In labs, accidents are part of the process.

scientific.setup: A service robot is acting strangely — repeating the same actions, deviating from its usual route, watching people.

choices.label: Interact with the robot to diagnose the issue
choices.flavor: Partial memory corruption. Fixing it grants you access to fragments of data it was carrying.

choices.label: Report the malfunction to maintenance
choices.flavor: Technician logged. The robot is retired. You did something concretely good.

choices.label: Follow it discreetly
choices.flavor: It leads to a room it normally services. Its deviant routine reveals an uncharted shortcut.

ruins.setup: An intact room amid the ruins — as if time stopped there on the day of the catastrophe. Table set, glass tipped over, hologram frozen.

choices.label: Touch the hologram to restart it
choices.flavor: It resumes. A meeting. People talking about something that will now never happen.

choices.label: Search the room methodically
choices.flavor: Everyday objects that have a value now they never should have had.

choices.label: Leave without touching anything
choices.flavor: Some things deserve to stay as they are. A form of respect.

ruins.setup: A partially collapsed corridor — a gap wide enough to squeeze through sideways. Light on the other side.

choices.label: Push through despite the collapse risk
choices.flavor: You get through. The structure cracks. You run. You arrive on the other side with plaster in your hair and an unknown item.

choices.label: Throw something first to test stability
choices.flavor: The structure holds. You pass carefully. The room beyond belonged to an officer.

choices.label: Don't take the risk
choices.flavor: Wise. Ruins don't improve with time.

ruins.setup: Inscriptions on the walls — names, dates, messages left by survivors right after. A human archive.

choices.label: Read them all — take your time
choices.flavor: Dozens of names. Hundreds of messages. You understand better what this place was.

choices.label: Photograph the inscriptions
choices.flavor: Historical data. Someone will pay for this — a historian, an archivist, a family.

choices.label: Find one that mentions a specific place
choices.flavor: A message describing a stash. The survivors planned a return that never happened.

ruins.setup: An alarm system from the original structure has restarted — short, regular sounds coming from everywhere and nowhere.

choices.label: Find the source and shut it off
choices.flavor: It's in an electrical cabinet. Fifty years of charge on a backup battery. Turning it off, you find what it was powering.

choices.label: Ignore it and continue
choices.flavor: The sound continues. Your concentration is affected. But you still find what you were looking for.

choices.label: Back off — an active alarm can attract people
choices.flavor: Wise. Alarms in ruins are beacons for those who know how to listen.

ruins.setup: An intact survival pod. It was activated and never recovered. Someone never made it.

choices.label: Open the pod
choices.flavor: It's empty. Opened from the inside long ago. The person left. The equipment is still there.

choices.label: Leave the pod closed
choices.flavor: It might not be empty. You'd rather not know.

choices.label: Report the coordinates — someone might be looking for this pod
choices.flavor: A reward arrives later. The family of someone missing. It matters.

ruins.setup: A seasoned scavenger picks through the same zone as you. He's seen you. He hasn't attacked. He's assessing.

choices.label: Offer to split the zone
choices.flavor: He agrees warily. You work in parallel. At the end you compare. He had the better section.

choices.label: Offer to work together
choices.flavor: Temporary alliance. He knows the ruins better than you. You find more together than you would alone.

choices.label: Try to intimidate him into giving up his section
choices.flavor: He's not easily intimidated. You're going to have to settle this seriously now.

ruins.setup: A preserved library — the books survived better than the walls that held them.

choices.label: Look for something useful among the books
choices.flavor: Technical manuals from a bygone era. Some information is still true.

choices.label: Take a random book and leave
choices.flavor: You'll get around to reading it later. Or not. The intention counts for something.

choices.label: Look for non-public documents
choices.flavor: The library kept private archives. Contracts. Correspondence. Forgotten debts.

ruins.setup: A backup generator still hums in an alcove — fifty years of residual charge powering something unknown.

choices.label: Follow the power cable
choices.flavor: It leads to a locked room the generator keeps shut. Or open. You don't know yet.

choices.label: Unplug the generator
choices.flavor: Something stops somewhere. You hear a door close for good.

choices.label: Leave the generator running — it might be doing something useful
choices.flavor: Someone programmed this for a reason. Not touching it is sometimes wise.

ruins.setup: A physical logbook, military cover, abandoned in a niche. The last pages are recent.

choices.label: Read the latest entries
choices.flavor: Coordinates, contact names, an incomplete extraction plan. Someone came here to recover something.

choices.label: Read the whole logbook from the start
choices.flavor: Weeks of entries. A complete human drama. And an ending you'd rather not have read.

choices.label: Leave it in place — not yours
choices.flavor: Whoever left it might come back for it.

ruins.setup: A human bone partially covered in dust. No context, no marking. It was here before the ruins.

choices.label: Search the area for whatever belonged to them
choices.flavor: A terminal, dried-up credits, a recorded message that was never sent.

choices.label: Pay a minimal gesture of respect and move on
choices.flavor: Something few do in the ruins. You remember it for a long time.

choices.label: Ignore it — the dead are just obstacles in the ruins
choices.flavor: You walk past. Probably the practical right call.

ruins.setup: A network of corridors leads to a section deliberately locked from the inside. Someone didn't want it getting out.

choices.label: Force the entry
choices.flavor: An emergency storage room. What's inside was prepared for a crisis that never came.

choices.label: Find another way in — there's always one
choices.flavor: A vent. Narrow. But it fits. What you found on the other side was worth the trip.

choices.label: Respect the lock
choices.flavor: What was sealed from the inside might have been for a good reason.

nature.setup: A creature watches you from the vegetation. It doesn't flee. It's assessing.

choices.label: Stay still and wait
choices.flavor: After ten minutes it approaches. Then leaves. Something just happened. You're not sure what.

choices.label: Approach slowly
choices.flavor: It backs away the same distance you advance. Not fear — protocol.

choices.label: Leave it be
choices.flavor: The best choice in every situation involving unknown creatures.

nature.setup: A plant you've never seen with visibly unusual properties — leaves that change color at a touch.

choices.label: Carefully pick a few leaves
choices.flavor: They keep their changed color. A botanist would pay well for this. Or an apothecary.

choices.label: Test one leaf — touch it and observe
choices.flavor: It warms slightly. Then stops. Harmless, or the start of something else. Hard to say.

choices.label: Photograph it and leave it
choices.flavor: Documentation has its value. And some exotic plants punish picking.

nature.setup: A particularly dense grove hides something — you feel it before you see it.

choices.label: Push into the grove
choices.flavor: At the center, a clear space. Arranged stones. Someone comes here regularly, for a reason you don't understand but respect.

choices.label: Go around the grove
choices.flavor: What you don't see can't complicate your life.

nature.setup: A local guide offers to show you rare species for a fee.

choices.label: Accept and pay him
choices.flavor: He takes you to places no map shows. You come back with knowledge and samples.

choices.label: Negotiate the price
choices.flavor: He agrees to less but shows you less. Proportionality is his philosophy.

choices.label: Refuse and explore alone
choices.flavor: You get lost three times. You still find something interesting.

nature.setup: An artificial river runs through the nature zone — an irrigation system close enough to a real stream to be disorienting.

choices.label: Follow the river upstream
choices.flavor: It leads to its source — a filtration reservoir with unguarded technical access.

choices.label: Follow the river downstream
choices.flavor: It disappears into the vegetation, then a drainage system. At the drain's edge, someone left something.

choices.label: Stay by the bank and rest
choices.flavor: The sound of artificial water is strangely soothing. You recover.

nature.setup: A nest of something — eggs, or organized structures that look like eggs.

choices.label: Don't touch it and leave
choices.flavor: The right call in 90% of situations involving a nest.

choices.label: Examine them closely without touching
choices.flavor: They're not eggs. They're spores from a plant that reproduces in spherical structures. Interesting.

choices.label: Take one to analyze
choices.flavor: It bursts. What was inside is on you now. Warm. Slightly stinging. You'll be fine.

luxury.setup: A restaurant table was left in a hurry — half-eaten meal, a knocked-over glass, a pushed-back chair.

choices.label: Eat what's left — not proud, but pragmatic
choices.flavor: Real cuisine. Not reconstituted. You promise yourself never to speak of this again.

choices.label: Find out what happened
choices.flavor: A discreet incident — someone recognized someone they shouldn't have. That has market value.

choices.label: Report the empty table to a waiter
choices.flavor: He thanks you with perfect professional politeness. You remember that politeness here is a mask.

luxury.setup: A wall safe, accidentally open — the door ajar, visible items inside.

choices.label: Take what's inside quickly
choices.flavor: Travel jewelry. Cash credits. An encrypted terminal. You take it and leave.

choices.label: Close the safe discreetly
choices.flavor: You do the right thing. Someone sees you do the right thing. You might reap something from that virtue.

choices.label: Take just the credits and close it
choices.flavor: An honest moral compromise. You took something, not everything. You tell yourself that counts.

luxury.setup: An influential figure is visibly bored in a waiting room. He looks at you like you might be an acceptable distraction.

choices.label: Start a conversation
choices.flavor: He's interested. You have something to say. He has something to offer. A rare exchange.

choices.label: Avoid him — influential figures are potential problems
choices.flavor: Wise in most contexts. Here, it might have been an opportunity.

choices.label: Flatter him openly
choices.flavor: He sees the flattery for what it is. And he likes it anyway. He gives you something for your paradoxical honesty.

luxury.setup: A private auction is taking place in a side room. The door is guarded but the guards are distracted.

choices.label: Enter the room
choices.flavor: No one asks for your ID. You seem to belong. What you buy — or observe — is worth the risk.

choices.label: Watch from the corridor
choices.flavor: You see faces. Names might come later. The information has value if you know who to sell it to.

luxury.setup: An upper-level bar you wouldn't normally have access to. The door is open — a cleaner steps out.

choices.label: Walk in confidently as if expected
choices.flavor: Confidence opens a lot of doors in luxury places. You order something. The bartender serves.

choices.label: Wait for someone else to enter and slip in
choices.flavor: It works. You go unnoticed. Twenty minutes of discreet luxury.

choices.label: Use the opening to steal a badge
choices.flavor: An employee's badge opens other doors than this one.

luxury.setup: A luxury artifact market — pieces priced in gold, not credits.

choices.label: Look around and assess the prices
choices.flavor: Some artifacts are underpriced by their current owners. You spot an opportunity.

choices.label: Sell something you have
choices.flavor: Here, a common artifact fetches three times its normal price. Word has spread.

choices.label: Offer a trade
choices.flavor: Luxury merchants prefer money. But they recognize the value of a rare thing.

luxury.setup: A gaming table in a private lounge — the cards are still there, the players gone. A bet-tracking terminal remains open.

choices.label: Analyze the terminal — read recent results
choices.flavor: The win patterns reveal a rigged table. Someone's been profiting for weeks. That information has a price.

choices.label: Wipe the terminal's data
choices.flavor: Someone loses proof. Someone else might be grateful someday without knowing why.

choices.label: Leave the terminal open and go
choices.flavor: Not your scandal.

luxury.setup: A well-known artist sells original pieces privately — bypassing official galleries. A rare opportunity.

choices.label: Buy a piece
choices.flavor: You don't know if it's an investment or madness. In this context, both are the same thing.

choices.label: Ask him why he sells here, like this
choices.flavor: He has debts or enemies or both. What he tells you could protect you or cause you trouble.

choices.label: Look but don't buy
choices.flavor: The art stays. So does the money. It's a choice.

luxury.setup: A business negotiation is happening in an open alcove — two parties and an empty chair. One of them looks at you.

choices.label: Sit down and present yourself as a neutral mediator
choices.flavor: They accept. You don't fully understand what's at stake. But your neutral presence shifts the balance in your favor.

choices.label: Refuse and politely pass
choices.flavor: A nod. A door closes on something that wasn't your concern.

choices.label: Listen from an adjacent spot before deciding
choices.flavor: What they're negotiating touches on something you know. You step in. You have an angle neither of them had.

military.setup: A soldier on break eats alone in a side corridor. He looks like someone who needs silence.

choices.label: Sit at a respectful distance
choices.flavor: He ends up talking to you. Not about what he does — about what he left behind. Worth hearing.

choices.label: Offer him something to eat
choices.flavor: He accepts with genuine surprise. A civilian offering something to a soldier — unexpected here.

choices.label: Pass without stopping
choices.flavor: He probably preferred that.

military.setup: A training area is visible from a walkway. Recruits drilling in formation.

choices.label: Watch the combat techniques closely
choices.flavor: You pick up something useful about coordination. Could come in handy.

choices.label: Look for an officer to ask for access to the area
choices.flavor: He's surprised by the direct request. He says no but respects you for asking.

military.setup: A secondary armory has its door unlocked. A technician inside is doing inventory.

choices.label: Enter and offer to help with the inventory
choices.flavor: He accepts. You work for two hours. You now know this armory's exact stock.

choices.label: Ask to buy something
choices.flavor: He can sell at the military rate if your reputation holds. Half the standard price.

choices.label: Quickly grab something while his back is turned
choices.flavor: He saw it in the reflection. He says nothing. He notes your face.

military.setup: A corridor leads to the central comms room. The door is open — a shift change underway.

choices.label: Slip in amid the shift-change confusion
choices.flavor: You catch fragments of communications. Information about movements, incidents, positions.

choices.label: Stay at the door and listen from the corridor
choices.flavor: Less risky. You hear less. But you still hear something.

choices.label: Keep walking without stopping
choices.flavor: Discretion is a valued quality in a military station.

military.setup: A board of active missions is visible in a passage corridor. Information that shouldn't be public.

choices.label: Read the board discreetly while passing
choices.flavor: Missions in sectors you know. Timings. Targets. Certain market value.

choices.label: Take a photo of the board
choices.flavor: A guard saw you. He approaches. You have ten seconds to find a credible explanation.

choices.label: Pass without stopping
choices.flavor: A civilian who doesn't look at military boards is a civilian guards don't have to watch.

military.setup: The officers' mess is accessible — a scheduling error leaves the room empty and the food ready.

choices.label: Eat quickly before someone arrives
choices.flavor: Officers' food is a different level. You eat fast but you eat well.

choices.label: Take something and leave
choices.flavor: Quality military food is currency in the right places.

choices.label: Leave without touching anything
choices.flavor: Officers count their rations. Civilians who touch them cause problems.

military.setup: A soldier discreetly asks for your help — he wants out. To desert. He has a uniform and nothing else.

choices.label: Help him find an unwatched exit
choices.flavor: You point out the passage. He gives you his access codes in exchange. Uncertain but real value.

choices.label: Refuse and ignore him
choices.flavor: He might find a way alone. He watches you leave with something in his eyes you'd rather not analyze.

choices.label: Report him to his superiors
choices.flavor: You're rewarded with a military contact. Someone else isn't rewarded at all.

military.setup: A patrol returns from an operation. Exhausted. Two lightly wounded. They don't notice you at the corridor entrance.

choices.label: Offer minimal medical help
choices.flavor: They accept warily. One of the wounded slips you an object without explanation. An implicit repayment.

choices.label: Listen to their informal debrief
choices.flavor: They talk among themselves. What they describe about the operation has value to anyone who knows how to listen.

choices.label: Pass without stopping
choices.flavor: They didn't see you. Probably for the best.

military.setup: A briefing room door was left open. A holographic map of a sector still spins at the center.

choices.label: Enter and memorize the map's contents
choices.flavor: Positions, patrol routes, blind spots. Information of real operational value.

choices.label: Close the door and quietly withdraw
choices.flavor: Someone was careless. Not your security problem.

choices.label: Wait for someone to return and pretend you're expected
choices.flavor: An officer enters. Surprised. Not alarmed. The situation could go very differently depending on your next sentence.

military.setup: A service weapon was abandoned in a patrol corridor — dropped, slid, or deliberately placed. Impossible to tell.

choices.label: Grab the weapon quickly
choices.flavor: You've got it. A standard military weapon. Having it could cause as many problems as it solves.

choices.label: Report the weapon to a nearby guard
choices.flavor: He notes it. You get a mention in a register. Might be worth something in this context.

choices.label: Don't touch it and move on quickly
choices.flavor: Not yours. In a military context, an abandoned weapon is an ownership problem.

generic.setup: A corridor that didn't interest you leads to something that does.

choices.label: Explore further
choices.flavor: A forgotten room. Forgotten things. Some have value.

choices.label: Stay on your path
choices.flavor: The detour might have been worth something. Maybe not.

generic.setup: An open maintenance access reveals the station's guts — cables, pipes, the invisible logistics.

choices.label: Enter and explore the infrastructure
choices.flavor: You discover a passage the station never knew about. Or forgot. It leads somewhere useful.

choices.label: Close it and leave
choices.flavor: Not where you needed to go.

generic.setup: A conversation between two people stops when you pass. They're waiting for you to be gone to resume.

choices.label: Slow down to hear more
choices.flavor: A few words. An address. A name. Maybe useful, probably not.

choices.label: Speed up — don't be the kind of person who listens in
choices.flavor: What they were saying probably didn't concern you.

generic.setup: An object falls from the pocket of someone walking away, unnoticed.

choices.label: Pick it up and return it
choices.flavor: They turn around, surprised. Something they couldn't afford to lose. Grateful.

choices.label: Pick it up and keep it
choices.flavor: A valuable item with no name on it is an unclaimed item.

choices.label: Keep walking without stopping
choices.flavor: Someone else might see it. Maybe not.

generic.setup: A public terminal is unlocked, giving access to non-public local information.

choices.label: Check the information
choices.flavor: Prices, rentals, wanted people. A temporary informational edge.

choices.label: Leave the terminal as is
choices.flavor: Non-public information often has owners who worry when it circulates.

generic.setup: A smell of real food comes from an apartment with its door ajar.

choices.label: Knock and ask if you can buy something
choices.flavor: A surprising family. They share their meal for credits and a conversation.

choices.label: Keep going — you don't knock on people's doors over a smell
choices.flavor: Social common sense wins out.
